name: mahad-nafsy
description: Mahad Nafsy — API + Admin + Client monorepo (mahadnafsy25)

scripts.lint:api: npx --yes eslint@8.57.0 --no-eslintrc -c api/.eslintrc.cjs api/routes/ api/lib/ api/middleware/ api/server.js
scripts.lint:admin: npm --prefix admin run lint && npm --prefix admin run typecheck
scripts.lint:client: npm --prefix client run lint && npm --prefix client run typecheck
scripts.test:e2e:install: npm --prefix e2e install && npm --prefix e2e run install:browsers
scripts.test: npm run lint:api && npm run test:unit && npm run smoke
scripts.qa:launch:static: npm run syntax:api && npm run lint:api && npm run lint:admin && npm run lint:client && npm run test:unit && npm run quality
scripts.qa:launch: npm run qa:launch:static && npm --prefix admin run build && npm --prefix client run build
scripts.install:all: cd api && npm install && cd ../admin && npm install && cd ../client && npm install
